title: Hold a water access licence
what: Take water from a watercourse, lake or well, or dispersed surface water, only under a water licence, unless the taking is allowed without one (for example under the rights in Part 5, an exemption or a temporary permission).

sources.title: Water Management Act 1999 (Tas)
sources.quote: A person must not, without a licence, take – (a) water from a watercourse, lake or well; or (b) dispersed surface water; or (c) water from a tidal area that a declaration under section 5A relates to
